Arc.description: Draws a curved line between two points (great-circle or bezier).

props.name: from
props.description: Start of the arc as [longitude, latitude].

props.name: to
props.description: End of the arc as [longitude, latitude].

props.name: beforeId
props.description: Insert before this existing layer id.

props.name: color
props.description: MUI palette token ("primary.main") or any CSS color. Default "primary.main".

props.name: curvature
props.description: Bulge factor for "bezier" arcs (0 = straight). Default 0.3.

props.name: dashed
props.description: Draw the line dashed instead of solid. Default false.

props.name: id
props.description: Explicit source/layer id. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: layerOverrides
props.description: Paint/layout patches merged into the generated line layer.

props.name: lineCap
props.description: How line ends are capped. Default "round".

props.name: lineJoin
props.description: How line corners are joined. Default "round".

props.name: onClick
props.description: Fired when the line is clicked, with the raw map event.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Line opacity, 0–1. Default 1.

props.name: points
props.description: Number of points sampled along the arc. Default 64.

props.name: type
props.description: "bezier" (flight-path bulge) or "geodesic" (great-circle). Default bezier.

props.name: width
props.description: Line width in pixels. Default 4.

ChoroplethLayer.description:
Data-driven polygon fill — a choropleth. Maps a numeric feature property to a
color ramp (smooth) or bands ("step"), painting GeoJSON polygons accordingly,
and optionally drops a themed <Legend> built from the same stops.

props.name: data
props.description: GeoJSON polygons to color.

props.name: property
props.description: Feature property whose numeric value drives the fill color.

props.name: stops
props.description: `[value, color]` stops in ascending order; colors may be palette tokens.

props.name: beforeId
props.description: Insert the layers before this existing layer id (e.g. a label layer).

props.name: fillOpacity
props.description: Fill opacity, 0–1. Default 0.6.

props.name: id
props.description: Unique source/layer id. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: layerOverrides
props.description: Paint/layout patches merged into the generated fill/line layers.

props.name: legend
props.description:
Render a matching <Legend> from the same stops — pass `true` for defaults,
or a config object to set its title, corner, and number format. The legend
shares this layer's stops, so the two can never drift apart.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Fired with the clicked feature and the raw map event.

props.name: scale
props.description: "interpolate" (smooth ramp, default) or "step" (banded).

props.name: strokeColor
props.description: Outline color (palette token or CSS). Default "divider".

props.name: strokeOpacity
props.description: Outline opacity, 0–1. Default 1.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Outline width in pixels. Default 1.

props.name: lineColor
props.description: Deprecated: use `strokeColor` instead.

props.name: lineOpacity
props.description: Deprecated: use `strokeOpacity` instead.

props.name: lineWidth
props.description: Deprecated: use `strokeWidth` instead.

Cluster.description:
Clusters a set of points using MapLibre's native clustering, rendering cluster
bubbles and single points as themed MUI markers. Clicking a cluster zooms in
to expand it.

Scaling note: the bubbles are DOM markers, so performance is bounded by how
many are *on screen* (comfortably hundreds), not by the dataset size. If a
view legitimately shows thousands of unclustered points at once, render them
with `PointLayer` or aggregate with `HexbinLayer` instead.

props.name: points
props.description: The points to cluster.

props.name: clusterProperties
props.description:
Aggregate point properties into each cluster (MapLibre
`clusterProperties`): a map of name → [operator, mapExpression], e.g.
`{ sales: ["+", ["get", "sales"]] }`. Aggregates arrive in
`renderCluster`'s third argument.

props.name: color
props.description: Cluster bubble color (palette token or CSS). Default "primary.main".

props.name: id
props.description: Unique source/layer id. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: maxZoom
props.description: Max zoom at which points cluster. Default 14.

props.name: onPointClick
props.description: Fired with the clicked unclustered point and its index in `points`.

props.name: pointColor
props.description: Unclustered point color. Default "secondary.main".

props.name: radius
props.description: Cluster radius in pixels. Default 50.

props.name: renderCluster
props.type: ((count: number, expand: () => void, properties: Record<string, unknown>) => ReactNode)
props.description:
Custom cluster bubble. Receives the count, a zoom-to-expand callback, and
the cluster's aggregated properties (see `clusterProperties`).

props.name: renderPoint
props.description: Custom single-point marker.

ContextMenu.description:
A theme-aware right-click menu anchored to a map coordinate. Ships with
center-here / copy-coordinates / drop-marker actions, or pass your own
`items`. Because it's a plain MUI <Menu>, it inherits the app theme.

props.name: defaultItems
props.description:
Include the built-in items. Defaults to true when `items` is omitted and
false when custom items are supplied (set true to append the defaults).

props.name: items
props.description:
Menu entries — a static array or a builder called with the click
coordinate. When omitted, the built-in center / copy / drop items show.

props.name: onDropMarker
props.description:
Handle the built-in "Drop marker" action. When omitted, the menu drops and
renders its own draggable markers (click one to remove it).

props.name: precision
props.description: Decimal places for the copied / displayed coordinate. Default 5.

DrawControl.description:
A drawing palette: pick point / line / polygon, then click the map to add
vertices (double-click or Enter to finish, Backspace to undo, Esc to cancel).
Completed shapes render through <ShapeLayer> / <PointLayer> and are emitted
via onChange / onCreate as plain GeoJSON.

props.name: color
props.description: Palette token or CSS color for the drawn shapes. Default "primary.main".

props.name: fillOpacity
props.description: Fill opacity for drawn polygons, 0–1. Default 0.3.

props.name: lineWidth
props.description: Width of drawn lines and outlines in pixels. Default 2.

props.name: modes
props.description: Which drawing tools to offer. Default point + line + polygon.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fired with the full feature list on every add / undo / clear.

props.name: onCreate
props.description: Fired once when a single shape is completed.

props.name: position
props.description: Corner for the tool palette. Default "top-left".

props.name: showClear
props.description: Show the "clear all" button. Default true.

ExtrusionLayer.description:
Extrudes GeoJSON polygons into 3D prisms (MapLibre `fill-extrusion`) — for
buildings or any value mapped to height. Height can be constant or driven by
a feature property; color can be a palette token or a data-driven choropleth.
Pitch the camera (e.g. MapControls' tilt button) to see the relief.

props.name: data
props.description: GeoJSON polygons to extrude.

props.name: base
props.description: Base height in meters — the floor the extrusion rises from. Default 0.

props.name: beforeId
props.description: Insert the layer before this existing layer id (e.g. a label layer).

props.name: fillColor
props.description: Fill — a palette token / CSS color, or a choropleth spec for data-driven color. Default "primary.main".

props.name: fillOpacity
props.description: Extrusion opacity, 0–1. Default 0.9.

props.name: height
props.description: Constant height in meters. Ignored when `heightProperty` is set. Default 0.

props.name: heightProperty
props.description: Feature property to drive height from (e.g. building floors × meters).

props.name: heightScale
props.description: Multiplier applied to `heightProperty` values. Default 1.

props.name: id
props.description: Unique source/layer id. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: layerOverrides
props.description: Paint/layout patches merged into the generated fill-extrusion layer.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Fired with the clicked feature and the raw map event.

props.name: color
props.description: Deprecated: use `fillColor` instead.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Deprecated: use `fillOpacity` instead.

GeocoderControl.description:
A themed place-search box for the map: MUI Autocomplete over a pluggable
geocoding provider. Picking a result flies the camera there (fitBounds
when the result has a bounding box) and drops a marker; both behaviors
can be turned off.

props.name: flyTo
props.description: Fly the camera to a picked result. Default true.

props.name: language
props.description: Preferred result language, passed through to the provider.

props.name: limit
props.description: Maximum number of results. Default 5.

props.name: marker
props.description: Drop a marker at the picked result. Default true.

props.name: noOptionsText
props.description: Empty-state text, also shown when the provider errors. Default "No places found".

props.name: onClear
props.description: Fires when the input is cleared.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Fires when the user picks a result.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Input placeholder, also used as the accessible label. Default "Search places…".

props.name: position
props.description: Corner of the map for the search box. Default "top-left".

props.name: provider
props.description: Built-in provider id or a custom GeocodingProvider. Default "photon".

props.name: proximity
props.description: Bias results toward a point. Default "map-center".

props.name: zoom
props.description: Target zoom when a picked result has no bounding box. Default 14.

GeoJSONLayer.description:
Low-level escape hatch: declaratively add a GeoJSON source + layers, kept
alive across theme-driven style swaps. Build Route/Arc/Cluster-style features
yourself when the higher-level components don't fit.

props.name: data
props.description:
GeoJSON rendered by the layers — inline data, or a URL string the map
fetches itself (any endpoint serving GeoJSON).

props.name: id
props.description: Unique id for the GeoJSON source backing these layers.

props.name: layers
props.description: One or more layers to render. Memoize this array to avoid churn.

props.name: beforeId
props.description: Insert the layers before this existing layer id (e.g. a label layer).

props.name: sourceOptions
props.description: Extra source options (clustering, generateId, …).

HeatmapLayer.description: Renders points as a density heatmap (MapLibre `heatmap` layer).

props.name: points
props.description: The points that feed the density surface.

props.name: beforeId
props.description: Insert the layer before this existing layer id.

props.name: colorRamp
props.description:
Override the density→color ramp: either `[density, color]` stops over the
0–1 density range (colors may be palette tokens, like HexbinLayer's
`colorRamp`), or a raw MapLibre expression.

props.name: id
props.description: Unique source/layer id. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Global density multiplier — higher reads hotter. Default 1.

props.name: layerOverrides
props.description: Paint/layout patches merged into the generated heatmap layer.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Heatmap opacity, 0–1. Default 0.85.

props.name: radius
props.description: Influence radius of each point in pixels. Default 20.

props.name: weightProperty
props.description: Feature property to weight points by (defaults to equal weight).

HexbinLayer.description:
Aggregates points into hexagonal or square cells colored by count (or a summed
weight) — a clearer read of density than a heatmap at a glance, and steadier
than clustering as you pan. Optionally extrudes each cell into a 3D column.

props.name: points
props.description: The points to aggregate into cells.

props.name: beforeId
props.description: Insert the layers before this existing layer id (e.g. a label layer).

props.name: cell
props.description: Cell shape — "hex" (default) or "square" grid.

props.name: colorRamp
props.description:
`[value, color]` stops for the bin color ramp; colors may be palette tokens.
Omit to auto-build a ramp spanning the data's `[0, max]`.

props.name: extruded
props.description: Render bins as 3D columns (height ∝ value). Pitch the camera to see them.

props.name: fillOpacity
props.description: Cell fill opacity, 0–1. Default 0.75.

props.name: heightScale
props.description: Meters of column height per unit value when extruded. Default scales max → ~1500m.

props.name: id
props.description: Unique source/layer id. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: layerOverrides
props.description:
Paint/layout patches merged into the generated layers. The `fill` role
covers both the flat fill and the extruded fill-extrusion variant.

props.name: onClick
props.type: ((bin: { value: number; count: number; }, event: MapLayerMouseEvent) => void)
props.description: Fired with the clicked cell's aggregates and the raw map event.

props.name: radius
props.description: Approximate cell size in kilometers. Default 50.

props.name: strokeColor
props.description: Cell outline color (flat mode). Default "background.paper".

props.name: strokeOpacity
props.description: Cell outline opacity, 0–1 (flat mode). Default 0.4.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Cell outline width in pixels (flat mode). Default 0.5.

props.name: weightProperty
props.description: Sum this point property instead of counting points.

props.name: lineColor
props.description: Deprecated: use `strokeColor` instead.

props.name: lineWidth
props.description: Deprecated: use `strokeWidth` instead.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Deprecated: use `fillOpacity` instead.

Layer.description:
Registers a named, toggleable overlay with the map's layer registry and shows
or hides its children based on visibility. Pair with <LayerControl>.

props.name: id
props.description: Unique id, used as the checkbox key in the control.

props.name: label
props.description: Label shown in the LayerControl.

props.name: children
props.description: Rendered while the layer is visible.

props.name: color
props.description: Palette token or CSS color for the control's swatch.

props.name: defaultVisible
props.description: Initial visibility for uncontrolled usage. Default true.

props.name: group
props.description: Optional section heading to group the layer under in the control.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional icon shown in the control (set once at registration).

props.name: onVisibleChange
props.description: Fired when the LayerControl toggles a controlled layer — update `visible` here.

props.name: visible
props.description: Controlled visibility — when set, the parent owns the state.

LayerControl.description:
A collapsible MUI panel that lists registered overlay layers as checkboxes and
toggles their visibility. Layers come from declarative <Layer> children and/or
the `layers` config prop — both feed the same registry. Heavily customizable
via icons, slot props, and `renderItem` / `renderTrigger` render props.

props.name: collapseIcon
props.description: Icon for the collapse button. Default a close (×) icon.

props.name: colorCheckbox
props.description: Tint each checkbox with its layer `color`. Default uses the theme primary.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Start with the panel expanded. Default false (just the icon button).

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon for the trigger button + header. Default a layers icon.

props.name: layers
props.description: Optional config-driven layers, in addition to any declarative <Layer>s.

props.name: position
props.description: Corner to anchor the control. Default "top-right".

props.name: renderItem
props.description: Fully render a row yourself (icon, badges, actions, …).

props.name: renderTrigger
props.description: Replace the collapsed trigger button entirely.

props.name: slotProps
props.description: Props forwarded to the inner MUI Paper / Checkbox.

props.name: sx
props.description: sx applied to the expanded panel (Paper).

props.name: title
props.description: Heading for the panel (and the trigger's tooltip). Default "Layers".

props.name: width
props.description: Panel width in px.

Legend.description:
A themed map legend. Because it is plain MUI it inherits the app's theme
(light/dark, palette, shape) automatically. Pass the same `ChoroplethSpec`
your `ShapeLayer` uses to keep the legend in sync with the layer, or an
`items` list for a categorical legend.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Format numeric stop values shown on a `spec`-driven legend.

props.name: items
props.description: Discrete swatches for a categorical legend. Takes precedence over `spec`.

props.name: position
props.description: Corner to anchor the legend. Default "bottom-right".

props.name: spec
props.description:
Drive the legend from the same `ChoroplethSpec` a `ShapeLayer` fill takes,
so the legend and its layer share one source of truth. "interpolate"
(default) renders a continuous gradient ramp; "step" renders banded swatches.

props.name: title
props.description: Optional heading shown above the legend body.

Map.description:
The map container. Creates a MapLibre GL instance, exposes it via context to
children (markers, controls, layers…), and swaps the basemap style when the
MUI theme mode changes.

props.name: animate
props.description:
How `view` changes move the camera: `true` (default) eases with MapLibre's
default animation, `false` jumps instantly, or pass `AnimationOptions`
(duration, easing…) for a custom transition.

props.name: center
props.description: Shorthand for `initialView.center`. Initial-only, like `initialView`.

props.name: children
props.description: Map content — rendered once the map has loaded. Typically markers, popups, controls, and layers.

props.name: colorScheme
props.description: "auto" follows the MUI theme (default); "light"/"dark" force a basemap.

props.name: fallback
props.description:
Rendered in place of the map when it fails to initialize. Defaults to a
themed panel with a "Unable to load the map" message.

props.name: fitBounds
props.description:
Declarative fitBounds: whenever this prop changes, the camera adjusts to
fit the bounds. For one-off imperative moves, use the map ref instead.

props.name: fitBoundsOptions
props.description: Options for `fitBounds` (padding, maxZoom…).

props.name: hideAttribution
props.description: Hide MapLibre's built-in attribution control (attribute elsewhere).

props.name: infinite
props.description:
Let the map wrap/repeat horizontally and scroll forever. Default false —
the map shows a single, non-wrapping world (a barrier), instead of the
infinite east-west repetition MapLibre renders by default.

props.name: initialView
props.description: Initial camera position. Applied once at creation — use `view` to move the camera later.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Allow user pan/zoom/rotate. Default true.

props.name: loader
props.description:
Show a loading indicator while the map initializes. Off by default. Pass
`true` for the built-in themed loader, or a ReactNode to render your own
indicator instead. Either way it is removed once the map has loaded.

props.name: loaderProps
props.description:
Configures the built-in loader — variant ("overlay" frosted screen,
"spinner", or "bar"), label, controlled `progress` (0–100), and spinner
`size`. Ignored when `loader` is a custom ReactNode.

props.name: mapOptions
props.description: Escape hatch for any other MapLibre map option.

props.name: maxZoom
props.description: Highest zoom level the camera allows.

props.name: minZoom
props.description: Lowest zoom level the camera allows.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Click on the map. `e.lngLat` has the clicked coordinate.

props.name: onContextMenu
props.description: Right-click / long-press on the map.

props.name: onDblClick
props.description: Double-click on the map.

props.name: onError
props.description:
Called when the map instance fails to initialize (e.g. WebGL unavailable)
or emits a runtime error event (e.g. a tile request failing). On
initialization failure, a themed fallback replaces the map — see
`fallback` to customize it.

props.name: onLoad
props.description: Called once with the map instance after the "load" event.

props.name: onMove
props.description: Fires continuously while the camera moves (pan, zoom, rotate).

props.name: onMoveEnd
props.description: Fires once when a camera movement settles.

props.name: onZoomEnd
props.description: Fires once when a zoom gesture/animation settles.

props.name: projection
props.description:
Map projection. `"globe"` renders the world as a 3D sphere (most visible at
low zoom); `"mercator"` is the flat default. Survives theme swaps.

props.name: provider
props.description:
Basemap source: a built-in id ("carto" | "osm"), a custom MapProvider,
a raw style URL, or a full MapLibre StyleSpecification. Defaults to "carto".

props.name: view
props.description:
Reactive camera position: whenever this prop changes, the map eases to it
(only the fields you provide are applied). Unlike `initialView`, the user
can still pan/zoom freely between changes — pair with `onMoveEnd` to track
where they went. Changes that match the current camera are ignored, so
feeding `onMoveEnd`'s view state back into `view` doesn't loop.

props.name: zoom
props.description: Shorthand for `initialView.zoom`. Initial-only, like `initialView`.

MapControls.description:
A cluster of MUI-styled map controls. Because it is plain MUI, it inherits the
app's theme automatically (light/dark, colors, shape).

props.name: pitchAmount
props.description: Pitch (degrees) the tilt toggle eases to. Default 60.

props.name: position
props.description: Corner for the zoom/compass/geolocate/fullscreen cluster.

props.name: scalePosition
props.description: Corner for the scale bar. Default "bottom-left".

props.name: scaleUnit
props.description: Scale bar units. Default "metric".

props.name: showCompass
props.description: Show the compass (reset-north) button. Default true.

props.name: showFullscreen
props.description: Show the fullscreen toggle. Default true.

props.name: showGeolocate
props.description: Show the "my location" button. Default true.

props.name: showPitch
props.description: Show a 3D tilt toggle that pitches the camera (for fill-extrusion layers).

props.name: showScale
props.description: Show a scale bar. Default false.

props.name: showZoom
props.description: Show the zoom in/out buttons. Default true.

Marker.description:
A map marker that renders arbitrary MUI content via a React portal into a
MapLibre marker. With no children it shows a themed pin.

props.name: latitude
props.description: Latitude of the marker position.

props.name: longitude
props.description: Longitude of the marker position.

props.name: anchor
props.description: Which part of the marker sits on the coordinate. Set at creation time.

props.name: children
props.description: Custom marker content (any MUI element). Falls back to a themed pin.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Allow the user to drag the marker.

props.name: label
props.description:
Accessible name for the marker (`aria-label`). Recommended whenever
`onClick` is set — interactive markers are keyboard-focusable buttons.

props.name: offset
props.description: Pixel offset from the anchor point.

props.name: onClick
props.description:
Click handler. Also makes the marker keyboard-accessible: it becomes
focusable with `role="button"`, and Enter/Space activate it.

props.name: onDragEnd
props.description: Fired after a drag ends, with the marker's new [lng, lat].

props.name: rotation
props.description: Rotation in degrees.

MeasureControl.description:
A measuring tape: draw a line to read its length, or a polygon to read its
area. Values surface live (while drawing) and per-shape in deletable MUI
chips. Built on the same engine as <DrawControl>.

props.name: color
props.description: Palette token or CSS color for the drawn measurements.

props.name: modes
props.description: Tools to offer. Default distance (line) + area (polygon).

props.name: position
props.description: Corner for the tool palette. Default "top-left".

props.name: readoutPosition
props.description: Corner for the measurement readout chips. Default "top-right".

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit system for the readouts. Default "metric".

PointLayer.description:
Renders many points as a single GPU circle layer — cheaper than one DOM
Marker per point. For rich/interactive content, use Marker instead.

props.name: points
props.description: The points to draw as circles.

props.name: beforeId
props.description: Insert the layer before this existing layer id (e.g. a label layer).

props.name: fillColor
props.description: Circle fill color (palette token or CSS). Default "primary.main".

props.name: fillOpacity
props.description: Circle fill opacity, 0–1. Default 1.

props.name: id
props.description: Unique source/layer id. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: layerOverrides
props.description: Paint/layout patches merged into the generated circle layer.

props.name: onClick
props.type: ((point: BasePoint, index: number, event: MapLayerMouseEvent) => void)
props.description: Fired with the clicked point, its index in `points`, and the raw event.

props.name: radius
props.description: Circle radius in pixels. Default 6.

props.name: strokeColor
props.description: Circle outline color (palette token or CSS). Default "background.paper".

props.name: strokeOpacity
props.description: Circle outline opacity, 0–1. Default 1.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Circle outline width in pixels. Default 1.5.

props.name: color
props.description: Deprecated: use `fillColor` instead.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Deprecated: use `fillOpacity` instead.

Popup.description:
A theme-aware popup anchored to a coordinate. Renders MUI content via a portal
into a MapLibre popup, styled to match the current MUI surface (incl. dark).

props.name: latitude
props.description: Latitude of the anchor coordinate.

props.name: longitude
props.description: Longitude of the anchor coordinate.

props.name: anchor
props.description: Edge to pin to the coordinate (e.g. "bottom"). Auto-chosen to fit the view when omitted.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the popup dialog. Default "Map popup".

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the popup.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class name(s) for the popup container.

props.name: closeButton
props.description: Show the X button. Default true.

props.name: closeOnClick
props.description: Close when the map is clicked. Default true.

props.name: closeOnMove
props.description: Close when the map moves. Default false.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: CSS max-width of the popup. Default "320px".

props.name: offset
props.description: Pixel offset from the coordinate — a number, [x, y], or a per-anchor map.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Fired when MapLibre closes the popup (X button, click, or move).

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled visibility. Default true.

RasterLayer.description: Renders raster tiles (XYZ/WMS) as a MapLibre `raster` layer.

props.name: attribution
props.description: Attribution shown for this source.

props.name: beforeId
props.description: Insert the layer before this existing layer id.

props.name: id
props.description: Shared source/layer id. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: layerOverrides
props.description: Per-role paint/layout patch for the raster layer.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Raster opacity, 0–1. Default 1.

props.name: sourceOptions
props.description: Escape hatch merged into the raster source spec (WMS, bounds, min/maxzoom).

props.name: tiles
props.description: XYZ tile URL template(s).

props.name: tileSize
props.description: Tile size in px. Default 256.

props.name: url
props.description: Alias for a single tile URL template.

Route.description: Draws a polyline (LineString) on the map from a list of coordinates.

props.name: coordinates
props.description: The line's vertices as [longitude, latitude] pairs, in draw order.

props.name: beforeId
props.description: Insert before this existing layer id.

props.name: color
props.description: MUI palette token ("primary.main") or any CSS color. Default "primary.main".

props.name: dashed
props.description: Draw the line dashed instead of solid. Default false.

props.name: id
props.description: Explicit source/layer id. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: layerOverrides
props.description: Paint/layout patches merged into the generated line layer.

props.name: lineCap
props.description: How line ends are capped. Default "round".

props.name: lineJoin
props.description: How line corners are joined. Default "round".

props.name: onClick
props.description: Fired when the line is clicked, with the raw map event.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Line opacity, 0–1. Default 1.

props.name: width
props.description: Line width in pixels. Default 4.

SelectControl.description:
Drag a marquee box or freehand lasso to select <PointLayer> features. While a
tool is armed, panning is suspended so the drag draws a selection; release to
select. Selected points are highlighted and reported via onSelect.

props.name: points
props.description: The same points fed to your <PointLayer>. Selection runs against these.

props.name: defaultTool
props.description: Tool armed on mount. Default none (with a toolbar) / the first tool (without).

props.name: highlight
props.description: Highlight the selected points. Default true.

props.name: highlightColor
props.description: Palette token or CSS color for the highlight. Default "secondary.main".

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Fired on every completed selection with the hit points and their indices.

props.name: position
props.description: Corner for the tool palette. Default "top-left".

props.name: selectionColor
props.description: Palette token or CSS color for the marquee / lasso. Default "primary.main".

props.name: showToolbar
props.description: Show the toolbar. When false, `defaultTool` (or the first tool) stays armed.

props.name: tools
props.description: Tools to offer. Default box + lasso.

ShapeLayer.description: Renders GeoJSON polygons/lines as fill + outline layers, with optional choropleth fill.

props.name: data
props.description: GeoJSON polygons and/or lines.

props.name: beforeId
props.description: Insert the layers before this existing layer id (e.g. a label layer).

props.name: fillColor
props.description: A palette token / CSS color, or a choropleth spec for data-driven fill.

props.name: fillOpacity
props.description: Fill opacity, 0–1. Default 0.4.

props.name: id
props.description: Unique source/layer id. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: layerOverrides
props.description: Paint/layout patches merged into the generated fill/line layers.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Fired with the clicked feature and the raw map event.

props.name: strokeColor
props.description: Outline color (palette token or CSS). Default "primary.main".

props.name: strokeOpacity
props.description: Outline opacity, 0–1. Default 1.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Outline width in pixels. Default 1.5.

props.name: lineColor
props.description: Deprecated: use `strokeColor` instead.

props.name: lineOpacity
props.description: Deprecated: use `strokeOpacity` instead.

props.name: lineWidth
props.description: Deprecated: use `strokeWidth` instead.

SymbolLayer.description:
Text labels (optionally with an icon) rendered as a single GPU symbol layer
— MapLibre declutters overlapping labels automatically as you zoom. For
rich interactive content, use Marker instead.

props.name: points
props.description: The labeled points to render.

props.name: allowOverlap
props.description: Draw labels even when they collide. Default false (MapLibre declutters).

props.name: anchor
props.description: Which side of the coordinate the text sits on. Default "top".

props.name: beforeId
props.description: Insert the layer before this existing layer id.

props.name: color
props.description: Text color — palette token or CSS. Default "text.primary".

props.name: font
props.description:
Font stack, e.g. `["Open Sans Bold"]`. Must exist in the basemap's glyph
set; when omitted, the style's default fonts are used.

props.name: haloColor
props.description: Halo behind the text for basemap contrast. Default "background.paper".

props.name: haloWidth
props.description: Halo width in px. Default 1.2.

props.name: icon
props.description:
Optional icon drawn at the coordinate beneath the label: an image URL
(PNG/JPEG/WebP) loaded and registered with the map. `size` scales it
(1 = native pixels).

props.name: id
props.description: Unique source/layer id. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: layerOverrides
props.description: Paint/layout patches merged into the generated symbol layer.

props.name: offset
props.description: Text offset in ems, [x, y]. Default [0, 0.4] (just under the point).

props.name: onClick
props.type: ((point: SymbolPoint, index: number, event: MapLayerMouseEvent) => void)
props.description: Fired with the clicked point, its index in `points`, and the raw event.

props.name: size
props.description: Text size in px. Default 12.

terrariumDem.description: The free AWS Terrarium elevation tileset — the default terrain DEM source.

Terrain.description:
Enables 3D terrain: adds a raster-DEM source and calls `setTerrain`, with an
optional atmospheric sky. Re-applies itself on mount, whenever a prop
changes (e.g. `exaggeration`, `sky`), and after theme-driven style swaps;
disables terrain and resets the sky on unmount.

props.name: demSource
props.description:
Raster-DEM tile URL template or explicit tiles array. Defaults to the free
AWS Terrarium elevation tileset (`terrariumDem`) — fair use; self-host for
production traffic.

props.name: demSourceOptions
props.description: Escape hatch merged into the raster-dem source spec.

props.name: encoding
props.description: DEM encoding. Default "terrarium" (matches the default source).

props.name: exaggeration
props.description: Vertical exaggeration of the terrain. Default 1.

props.name: id
props.description: Stable raster-dem source id. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: sky
props.description: Add an atmospheric sky. `true` uses a default; pass a spec to customize.

props.name: tileSize
props.description: DEM tile size in px. Default 256.

TimePlayback.description:
Animates time-stamped GeoJSON points along a playhead — great for trips and
trajectories. Renders a faint cumulative (or trailing) trail plus a bright
"head" of the most-recent points, driven by a themed MUI transport bar
(play/pause, scrubber, speed). Filtering happens on the GPU, so it stays
smooth with many points. Playhead and playing state follow the standard
controlled/uncontrolled pattern.

props.name: data
props.description: GeoJSON points, each carrying a numeric timestamp property.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Start playing on mount (uncontrolled initial). Default false.

props.name: beforeId
props.description: Insert the layers before this existing layer id.

props.name: color
props.description: Head (most-recent) point color — palette token or CSS. Default "primary.main".

props.name: defaultPlayhead
props.description: Initial playhead for uncontrolled use. Defaults to the data's min time.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one full playthrough at 1×. Default 12.

props.name: formatTime
props.description: Format the playhead value shown on the transport bar.

props.name: id
props.description: Unique source/layer id. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: layerOverrides
props.description: Paint/layout patches merged into the generated trail/head layers.

props.name: loop
props.description: Loop back to the start at the end. Default true.

props.name: onPlayingChange
props.description: Fired when the transport wants to start or stop (toggle, end reached).

props.name: onTimeChange
props.description: Called whenever the playhead advances or is scrubbed.

props.name: playhead
props.description:
Controlled playhead value. Pair with `onTimeChange` to own playback state;
omit to let the component manage it internally.

props.name: playing
props.description: Controlled playing state. Pair with `onPlayingChange`.

props.name: position
props.description: Corner to anchor the transport bar. Default "bottom-left".

props.name: radius
props.description: Head point radius in px. Default 6.

props.name: showTransport
props.description: Render the transport bar. Default true.

props.name: timeProperty
props.description: Name of the numeric timestamp property. Default "time".

props.name: trail
props.description:
Visible trailing window, in the same units as the timestamps: only points
with `playhead - trail ≤ t ≤ playhead` show. Omit for a cumulative trail —
everything up to the playhead stays on screen.

props.name: trailColor
props.description: Trail point color. Defaults to `color`.

Tooltip.description:
A lightweight, non-interactive label anchored to a coordinate — a Popup with
no close button and tighter padding. Pair it with a Marker's hover state.

props.name: latitude
props.description: Latitude of the anchor coordinate.

props.name: longitude
props.description: Longitude of the anchor coordinate.

props.name: anchor
props.description: Edge to pin to the coordinate (e.g. "bottom"). Auto-chosen to fit the view when omitted.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the popup dialog. Default "Map popup".

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the popup.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class name(s) for the popup container.

props.name: closeOnMove
props.description: Close when the map moves. Default false.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: CSS max-width of the popup. Default "320px".

props.name: offset
props.description: Pixel offset from the coordinate — a number, [x, y], or a per-anchor map.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Fired when MapLibre closes the popup (X button, click, or move).

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled visibility. Default true.

exports.name: Arc
exports.description: Draws a curved line between two points (great-circle or bezier).

exports.name: ArcOptions
exports.description: Options controlling how `generateArc` interpolates between two points.

exports.name: ArcProps
exports.description: Props for `<Arc>`, a curved line between two points (great-circle or bezier).

exports.name: ArcType
exports.description: Arc interpolation style: "bezier" (flight-path bulge) or "geodesic" (great-circle).

exports.name: BasePoint
exports.description: The minimal point shape shared by every point-driven layer (PointLayer, SymbolLayer, HeatmapLayer, HexbinLayer, Cluster). Component-specific point types extend this base, so helpers written against `BasePoint` accept them all.

exports.name: BinnedFeatureCollection
exports.description: A FeatureCollection of bin polygons, as returned by `binPoints`.

exports.name: BinOptions
exports.description: Options controlling how `binPoints` aggregates points into cells.

exports.name: BinPoint
exports.description: A point aggregated by `binPoints` (and rendered by `<HexbinLayer>`).

exports.name: binPoints
exports.description: Aggregates scattered lng/lat points into hexagonal or square cells, returning a GeoJSON polygon per non-empty cell with `{ value, count }`. Binning happens on a local equirectangular plane (km) centered on the data's mean latitude — exact enough for city/region-scale views, approximate near the poles or across very wide extents.

exports.name: BinProperties
exports.description: Aggregated value (`count`, or summed `weightProperty`) carried by each bin.

exports.name: buildColorExpression
exports.description: Builds a MapLibre paint expression from a choropleth spec.

exports.name: carto
exports.description: CARTO basemaps — free, no API key for development. "positron" is the light style, "dark-matter" the dark one, so the map tracks the MUI theme nicely.

exports.name: ChoroplethLayer
exports.description: Data-driven polygon fill — a choropleth. Maps a numeric feature property to a color ramp (smooth) or bands ("step"), painting GeoJSON polygons accordingly, and optionally drops a themed <Legend> built from the same stops.

exports.name: ChoroplethLayerProps
exports.description: Props for `<ChoroplethLayer>`, a data-driven polygon fill (choropleth).

exports.name: ChoroplethLegendConfig
exports.description: Configures the optional `<Legend>` a `<ChoroplethLayer>` can render from its own stops.

exports.name: ChoroplethSpec
exports.description: Drives a layer's fill color from a feature property — a choropleth. `stops` are `[value, color]` pairs in ascending order; colors may be palette tokens.

exports.name: Cluster
exports.description: Clusters a set of points using MapLibre's native clustering, rendering cluster bubbles and single points as themed MUI markers. Clicking a cluster zooms in to expand it.

exports.name: ClusterPoint
exports.description: A point clustered by `<Cluster>`.

exports.name: ClusterProps
exports.description: Props for `<Cluster>`, which clusters points using MapLibre's native clustering.

exports.name: ColorMode
exports.description: The effective color mode a basemap is rendered in.

exports.name: ColorScheme
exports.description: "auto" follows the MUI theme; "light"/"dark" force a basemap.

exports.name: ContextMenu
exports.description: A theme-aware right-click menu anchored to a map coordinate. Ships with center-here / copy-coordinates / drop-marker actions, or pass your own `items`. Because it's a plain MUI <Menu>, it inherits the app theme.

exports.name: ContextMenuItem
exports.description: A single row in a `<ContextMenu>`.

exports.name: ContextMenuItemContext
exports.description: The map location passed to a `ContextMenuItem`'s `onClick`.

exports.name: ContextMenuProps
exports.description: Props for `<ContextMenu>`, a theme-aware right-click menu anchored to a map coordinate.

exports.name: ControlPosition
exports.description: Which corner of the map a control is anchored to.

exports.name: DrawControl
exports.description: A drawing palette: pick point / line / polygon, then click the map to add vertices (double-click or Enter to finish, Backspace to undo, Esc to cancel). Completed shapes render through <ShapeLayer> / <PointLayer> and are emitted via onChange / onCreate as plain GeoJSON.

exports.name: DrawControlProps
exports.description: Props for `<DrawControl>`, a drawing palette for point/line/polygon shapes.

exports.name: DrawEngine
exports.description: The state and actions returned by `useDraw`.

exports.name: DrawFeature
exports.description: A completed shape produced by `useDraw` — plain GeoJSON with `DrawFeatureProperties`.

exports.name: DrawFeatureProperties
exports.description: Properties `useDraw` attaches to every completed `DrawFeature`.

exports.name: DrawMode
exports.description: Which drawing tool is active: point, line, or polygon.

exports.name: ExtrusionLayer
exports.description: Extrudes GeoJSON polygons into 3D prisms (MapLibre `fill-extrusion`) — for buildings or any value mapped to height. Height can be constant or driven by a feature property; color can be a palette token or a data-driven choropleth. Pitch the camera (e.g. MapControls' tilt button) to see the relief.

exports.name: ExtrusionLayerProps
exports.description: Props for `<ExtrusionLayer>`, which extrudes GeoJSON polygons into 3D prisms.

exports.name: featureCollection
exports.description: Wraps a list of features in a GeoJSON FeatureCollection.

exports.name: FeatureStateOptions
exports.description: Options for `useFeatureState`.

exports.name: formatArea
exports.description: Formats an area in m² as a human label ("850 m²", "1.20 km²", "3.4 ac").

exports.name: formatDistance
exports.description: Formats a distance in metres as a human label ("850 m", "1.20 km", "2.4 mi").

exports.name: generateArc
exports.description: Generates the coordinate path for an arc between two points.

exports.name: GeocodeOptions
exports.description: Options passed to GeocodingProvider.search.

exports.name: GeocoderControl
exports.description: A themed place-search box for the map: MUI Autocomplete over a pluggable geocoding provider. Picking a result flies the camera there (fitBounds when the result has a bounding box) and drops a marker; both behaviors can be turned off.

exports.name: GeocoderControlProps
exports.description: Props for `<GeocoderControl>`, a themed place-search box over a pluggable geocoding provider.

exports.name: GeocodeResult
exports.description: One place returned by a geocoding provider.

exports.name: GeocoderId
exports.description: Id of a built-in geocoding provider.

exports.name: GeocoderInput
exports.description: A built-in provider id or a custom GeocodingProvider implementation.

exports.name: geocoders
exports.description: Built-in geocoding providers, keyed by id.

exports.name: GeocodingProvider
exports.description: A pluggable geocoding backend for GeocoderControl / useGeocoder.

exports.name: GeoJSONLayer
exports.description: Low-level escape hatch: declaratively add a GeoJSON source + layers, kept alive across theme-driven style swaps. Build Route/Arc/Cluster-style features yourself when the higher-level components don't fit.

exports.name: GeoJSONLayerProps
exports.description: Props for `<GeoJSONLayer>`, the low-level escape hatch for a declarative GeoJSON source + layers.

exports.name: haversineDistance
exports.description: Great-circle (haversine) distance between two lng/lat points, in metres.

exports.name: HeatmapLayer
exports.description: Renders points as a density heatmap (MapLibre `heatmap` layer).

exports.name: HeatmapLayerProps
exports.description: Props for `<HeatmapLayer>`, which renders points as a density heatmap.

exports.name: HexbinLayer
exports.description: Aggregates points into hexagonal or square cells colored by count (or a summed weight) — a clearer read of density than a heatmap at a glance, and steadier than clustering as you pan. Optionally extrudes each cell into a 3D column.

exports.name: HexbinLayerProps
exports.description: Props for `<HexbinLayer>`, which aggregates points into hexagonal or square cells colored by count.

exports.name: isChoroplethSpec
exports.description: True if a `fillColor` value is a choropleth spec rather than a plain color.

exports.name: isPmtilesRegistered
exports.description: True once the `pmtiles://` protocol has been registered on maplibre-gl.

exports.name: Layer
exports.description: Registers a named, toggleable overlay with the map's layer registry and shows or hides its children based on visibility. Pair with <LayerControl>.

exports.name: LayerConfig
exports.description: A fully-controlled layer definition for the `layers` config API.

exports.name: LayerControl
exports.description: A collapsible MUI panel that lists registered overlay layers as checkboxes and toggles their visibility. Layers come from declarative <Layer> children and/or the `layers` config prop — both feed the same registry. Heavily customizable via icons, slot props, and `renderItem` / `renderTrigger` render props.

exports.name: LayerControlProps
exports.description: Props for `<LayerControl>`, a collapsible MUI panel listing registered overlay layers as checkboxes.

exports.name: LayerEntry
exports.description: A registered overlay layer, as shown in the LayerControl panel.

exports.name: LayerInput
exports.description: A layer spec where `source` is optional (filled from the config id).

exports.name: LayerItemControls
exports.description: Handle passed to `renderItem` for a custom row.

exports.name: LayerOverride
exports.description: Paint/layout patches merged into a component-generated layer spec — the escape hatch when a high-level prop doesn't exist for a MapLibre property. Entries win over component-computed values.

exports.name: LayerPoint
exports.description: A point rendered by PointLayer.

exports.name: LayerProps
exports.description: Props for `<Layer>`, which registers a named, toggleable overlay with the map's layer registry.

exports.name: LayerRegistryValue
exports.description: The layer registry's state and mutators, provided by `<Map>`.

exports.name: Legend
exports.description: A themed map legend. Because it is plain MUI it inherits the app's theme (light/dark, palette, shape) automatically. Pass the same `ChoroplethSpec` your `ShapeLayer` uses to keep the legend in sync with the layer, or an `items` list for a categorical legend.

exports.name: LegendItem
exports.description: A single categorical legend row: swatch color + label.

exports.name: LegendProps
exports.description: Props for `<Legend>`, a themed map legend.

exports.name: lineDistance
exports.description: Total length of a path (sum of segment great-circle distances), in metres.

exports.name: lineFeature
exports.description: Wraps a list of [longitude, latitude] coordinates in a GeoJSON LineString Feature.

exports.name: LngLatTuple
exports.description: A [longitude, latitude] pair.

exports.name: Map
exports.description: The map container. Creates a MapLibre GL instance, exposes it via context to children (markers, controls, layers…), and swaps the basemap style when the MUI theme mode changes.

exports.name: MapContextValue
exports.description: The value provided by `<Map>` through `MapContext`.

exports.name: MapControls
exports.description: A cluster of MUI-styled map controls. Because it is plain MUI, it inherits the app's theme automatically (light/dark, colors, shape).

exports.name: MapControlsProps
exports.description: Props for `<MapControls>`, a cluster of MUI-styled map controls (zoom, compass, geolocate, fullscreen, scale).

exports.name: MapLayerConfig
exports.description: Declarative GeoJSON source + layers config consumed by `useMapLayer`.

exports.name: maplibregl
exports.description: The underlying MapLibre GL namespace, re-exported for power users.

exports.name: MapLoaderProps
exports.description: Configures the built-in `<Map>` loading indicator (see `Map`'s `loaderProps`).

exports.name: MapProps
exports.description: Props for `<Map>`, the container that creates and configures the MapLibre GL instance.

exports.name: MapProvider
exports.description: A pluggable basemap source. Implement this to add any MapLibre-compatible provider (MapTiler, Stadia, self-hosted, …) beyond the built-ins.

exports.name: MapStyleInput
exports.description: Anything accepted by the `provider` prop: a built-in id, a custom MapProvider, a raw style URL, or a full style spec.

exports.name: maptiler
exports.description: MapTiler basemaps — the natural production upgrade from the keyless built-ins. Requires a (free-tier) API key from https://cloud.maptiler.com. Because it's key'd, it's a factory rather than a bare provider const: call it with your key and pass the result to the `provider` prop.

exports.name: MapViewEventHandler
exports.description: A map-level event handler receiving the camera state after the event.

exports.name: MapViewState
exports.description: A camera position: center, zoom, bearing, and pitch.

exports.name: Marker
exports.description: A map marker that renders arbitrary MUI content via a React portal into a MapLibre marker. With no children it shows a themed pin.

exports.name: MarkerProps
exports.description: Props for `<Marker>`, a map marker that renders MUI content via a portal into a MapLibre marker.

exports.name: MeasureControl
exports.description: A measuring tape: draw a line to read its length, or a polygon to read its area. Values surface live (while drawing) and per-shape in deletable MUI chips. Built on the same engine as <DrawControl>.

exports.name: MeasureControlProps
exports.description: Props for `<MeasureControl>`, a measuring tape for line distance and polygon area.

exports.name: MeasureMode
exports.description: Which measurement tool is active: distance ("line") or area ("polygon").

exports.name: MeasureUnit
exports.description: Unit system for measurement readouts: metric (meters/km) or imperial (feet/miles).

exports.name: nominatim
exports.description: Nominatim (nominatim.openstreetmap.org) — OSM's classic geocoder. The public instance forbids heavy autocomplete (max ~1 req/s), so this provider ships with an 1100 ms debounce; `proximity` is ignored (no bias parameter). Self-host for production traffic.

exports.name: opentopomap
exports.description: OpenTopoMap raster tiles — free, no API key. A topographic basemap (contours, hillshading, hiking detail) rendered from OpenStreetMap + SRTM elevation data. Like OSM it ships a single raster style, so it looks the same in light and dark. Honor its fair-use tile policy in production.

exports.name: osm
exports.description: Standard OpenStreetMap raster tiles — free, no API key. One style serves both modes (OSM has no native dark raster set in v1).

exports.name: photon
exports.description: Photon (photon.komoot.io) — free OSM geocoder built for search-as-you-type. Fair-use public instance; point `search` at a self-hosted Photon for production traffic by supplying a custom provider instead.

exports.name: pointFeature
exports.description: Wraps a [longitude, latitude] coordinate in a GeoJSON Point Feature.

exports.name: pointInBox
exports.description: True when a point falls within the axis-aligned box defined by two corners.

exports.name: pointInPolygon
exports.description: Ray-casting point-in-polygon test in screen (pixel) space. The ring is an ordered list of vertices; it is treated as implicitly closed. Points exactly on an edge are reported inconsistently (as is standard for ray casting) — fine for lasso selection, where pixel-perfect edges don't matter.

exports.name: PointLayer
exports.description: Renders many points as a single GPU circle layer — cheaper than one DOM Marker per point. For rich/interactive content, use Marker instead.

exports.name: PointLayerProps
exports.description: Props for `<PointLayer>`, which renders many points as a single GPU circle layer.

exports.name: polygonArea
exports.description: Spherical area of a polygon ring, in square metres. The ring need not repeat its first point — it is treated as implicitly closed. Winding-order agnostic (always returns a non-negative area).

exports.name: Popup
exports.description: A theme-aware popup anchored to a coordinate. Renders MUI content via a portal into a MapLibre popup, styled to match the current MUI surface (incl. dark).

exports.name: PopupProps
exports.description: Props for `<Popup>`, a theme-aware popup anchored to a map coordinate.

exports.name: ProviderId
exports.description: One of the built-in basemap provider ids ("carto", "osm", "versatiles", "opentopomap").

exports.name: providerKey
exports.description: A stable key for the provider, used to detect when a style swap is needed.

exports.name: providers
exports.description: Built-in providers, keyed by id.

exports.name: RasterLayer
exports.description: Renders raster tiles (XYZ/WMS) as a MapLibre `raster` layer.

exports.name: RasterLayerConfig
exports.description: Declarative raster source + layer config consumed by `useRasterLayer`.

exports.name: RasterLayerProps
exports.description: Props for `<RasterLayer>`, which renders XYZ/WMS raster tiles as a layer.

exports.name: registerPmtilesProtocol
exports.description: Register the `pmtiles://` protocol handler on maplibre-gl so styles and sources can reference `.pmtiles` archives. Idempotent and safe to call concurrently; the `pmtiles` package is dynamically imported, so it stays out of the base bundle and never runs at module load (SSR-safe).

exports.name: resolveAttribution
exports.description: The attribution string for a provider input, when one is known.

exports.name: resolveGeocoder
exports.description: Resolve a built-in id, or pass a custom provider through unchanged.

exports.name: resolvePaletteColor
exports.description: Resolves an MUI palette token ("primary.main", "error.light", or a top-level string entry like "divider") against the theme. Anything that isn't a known token (e.g. "#ff0000", "rgb(...)") is returned unchanged, so callers can pass raw CSS colors too.

exports.name: resolveStyle
exports.description: Resolves the `provider` prop + color mode into a MapLibre style.

exports.name: Route
exports.description: Draws a polyline (LineString) on the map from a list of coordinates.

exports.name: RouteProps
exports.description: Props for `<Route>`, which draws a polyline on the map from a list of coordinates.

exports.name: ScreenPoint
exports.description: A pixel-space point, matching MapLibre's `map.project()` return shape.

exports.name: SelectControl
exports.description: Drag a marquee box or freehand lasso to select <PointLayer> features. While a tool is armed, panning is suspended so the drag draws a selection; release to select. Selected points are highlighted and reported via onSelect.

exports.name: SelectControlProps
exports.description: Props for `<SelectControl>`, marquee/lasso selection over `<PointLayer>` features.

exports.name: SelectTool
exports.description: Which selection tool is active: a marquee box or a freehand lasso.

exports.name: ShapeLayer
exports.description: Renders GeoJSON polygons/lines as fill + outline layers, with optional choropleth fill.

exports.name: ShapeLayerProps
exports.description: Props for `<ShapeLayer>`, which renders GeoJSON polygons/lines as fill + outline layers.

exports.name: SymbolLayer
exports.description: Text labels (optionally with an icon) rendered as a single GPU symbol layer — MapLibre declutters overlapping labels automatically as you zoom. For rich interactive content, use Marker instead.

exports.name: SymbolLayerProps
exports.description: Props for `<SymbolLayer>`, text labels (optionally with an icon) rendered as a single GPU symbol layer.

exports.name: SymbolPoint
exports.description: A labeled point rendered by `<SymbolLayer>`.

exports.name: Terrain
exports.description: Enables 3D terrain: adds a raster-DEM source and calls `setTerrain`, with an optional atmospheric sky. Re-applies itself on mount, whenever a prop changes (e.g. `exaggeration`, `sky`), and after theme-driven style swaps; disables terrain and resets the sky on unmount.

exports.name: TerrainProps
exports.description: Props for `<Terrain>`, which drapes the basemap over 3D elevation.

exports.name: terrariumDem
exports.description: The free AWS Terrarium elevation tileset — the default terrain DEM source.

exports.name: TimePlayback
exports.description: Animates time-stamped GeoJSON points along a playhead — great for trips and trajectories. Renders a faint cumulative (or trailing) trail plus a bright "head" of the most-recent points, driven by a themed MUI transport bar (play/pause, scrubber, speed). Filtering happens on the GPU, so it stays smooth with many points. Playhead and playing state follow the standard controlled/uncontrolled pattern.

exports.name: TimePlaybackProps
exports.description: Props for `<TimePlayback>`, which animates time-stamped GeoJSON points along a playhead.

exports.name: Tooltip
exports.description: A lightweight, non-interactive label anchored to a coordinate — a Popup with no close button and tighter padding. Pair it with a Marker's hover state.

exports.name: TooltipProps
exports.description: Props for `<Tooltip>`, a lightweight non-interactive label anchored to a map coordinate.

exports.name: useColorScheme
exports.description: Resolves the effective basemap color mode, following the MUI theme on "auto".

exports.name: useDraw
exports.description: Headless drawing state machine: wires map clicks / double-click / move / keyboard into a point/line/polygon draft and a list of completed features. Both <DrawControl> and <MeasureControl> are thin shells over this.

exports.name: UseDrawOptions
exports.description: Options for `useDraw`.

exports.name: useFeatureState
exports.description: Tracks pointer hover over a layer and mirrors it into MapLibre feature-state, so paint expressions can react per feature:

exports.name: useGeocoder
exports.description: Headless place search: debounced, abortable, stale-safe. GeocoderControl is a thin MUI surface over this hook; use it directly for custom UIs.

exports.name: UseGeocoderOptions
exports.description: Options for useGeocoder.

exports.name: UseGeocoderResult
exports.description: State and actions returned by useGeocoder.

exports.name: useLayerRegistry
exports.description: Reads the layer registry. Throws if used outside <Map>.

exports.name: useLayerVisibility
exports.description: Returns whether a layer id is currently visible, falling back to `defaultVisible` until the layer has registered.

exports.name: useMap
exports.description: Returns the underlying MapLibre GL map instance, or null until it is ready. Use this to drop down to the raw MapLibre API whenever you need more control.

exports.name: useMapContext
exports.description: Reads the full map context. Throws if used outside <Map>.

exports.name: useMapLayer
exports.description: Adds a GeoJSON source + layers to the map and keeps them alive across theme-driven style swaps (MapLibre's `setStyle` wipes custom layers, so we re-add on `styledata`). Data and paint/layout updates are applied in place.

exports.name: useRasterLayer
exports.description: Adds a raster tile source + layer and keeps them alive across theme-driven style swaps (via `useStyleReapply`). Paint (`opacity`, `paint` overrides) is re-applied in place whenever it changes, so those props are reactive; the source itself (`tiles`, `tileSize`, `beforeId`, …) is mount-oriented and only recreated after a style swap wipes it. Removes both on unmount.

exports.name: versatiles
exports.description: VersaTiles basemaps — free, open, no API key and no signup. Vector tiles built from OpenStreetMap data and served from a community CDN. "colorful" is the light style and "eclipse" the dark one, so the map tracks the MUI theme the same way CARTO's positron/dark-matter pair does — but with no usage restrictions for commercial use.
